programs.title: News Breakfast
programs.desc: As each day begins get the facts you need to stay informed. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato present the latest news, overnight developments and today's top stories, joined by Catherine Murphy, Nate Byrne and Lillian Rangiah.

programs.title: ABC News Mornings
programs.desc: Stay in the know with what's happening this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Gemma Veness.

programs.title: Australian Story
programs.desc: In 2026, Logie-award-winning documentary program Australian Story celebrates 30 years sharing compelling stories about real people that illuminate, entertain and inspire. The power of the personal. Presented by Leigh Sales.

programs.title: Planet America
programs.desc: The Chaser's Chas Licciardello and the ABC's John Barron set out to discover the real America - its politics and its people - with US and Australian experts coming along for the ride. The host speaks about the history of America, the country's politics, customs, and traditions, and the life of the citizens.

programs.title: A Life in Ten Pictures
programs.desc: Ella Fitzgerald's image is famous around the world. But just a handful of iconic photographs and snapshots reveal a new story: it's an extraordinary life, seen through a unique lens.

programs.title: ABC News At Noon
programs.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. ABC News brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.
